authorized_evidence.content:
Vendor Onboarding

New vendors require a vendor intake request before work begins. The requester must provide vendor legal name, business purpose, expected start date, estimated annual spend, data access level, and contract owner.

| Vendor Risk | Example | Required Review |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Low | Office supplies, training materials | Operations |
| Moderate | Contractor with project files | Operations and Legal |
| High | Vendor processing company or customer data | Operations, Legal, IT Admin |
| Financial | Vendor paid through invoice or purchase order | Operations and Finance |

Vendors may not receive company data, customer data, credentials, or building access until required reviews are complete.
authorized_evidence.document_title: Vendor, Travel, and Equipment Operations Policy

authorized_evidence.content:
Procurement Thresholds

Purchases below USD 2,500 may be approved by the employee's manager if the purchase is within the team's approved budget. Purchases from USD 2,500 to USD 10,000 require Finance review before a purchase order is issued.

Purchases above USD 10,000 require Finance review, Legal review if a contract is involved, and department leader approval. Vendors that will process company data must complete the vendor security review before contract signature, even when the spend is below USD 10,000.

Contract Approval Process

| Contract Type | Legal Review | Finance Review | Final Approver |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard customer order form under USD 25,000 ARR | Optional unless redlines exist | Deal Desk | Sales Manager |
| Customer contract with security addendum | Required | Deal Desk | Sales Director |
| Vendor agreement under USD 10,000 | Required if data processing applies | Finance | Department Manager |
| Vendor agreement USD 10,000 or above | Required | Finance | Department Leader |
| Employment-related agreement | Required | HR Admin | People Leader |

No employee may sign a contract on behalf of Northstar unless they are listed in the signature authority register maintained by Legal Operations.

authorized_evidence.content:
Policy Scope

This policy covers vendor onboarding, business travel booking, equipment requests, shipping, and operations exceptions. It applies to employees, managers, HR Admins, and IT Admins who request operational support.

Finance controls reimbursement and procurement thresholds. Legal controls contract review. IT controls device security. This Operations policy explains process ownership and routing.
authorized_evidence.document_title: Vendor, Travel, and Equipment Operations Policy

authorized_evidence.content:
Related Policies

Travel bookings must follow the Operations travel process. Vendor contracts must follow Legal approval rules. Software purchases must follow IT security review rules before reimbursement or procurement approval.
